name: smalltalk_list_classes
description: List all classes in the system, optionally filtered by prefix.

prefix.description: Optional prefix to filter class names

name: smalltalk_method_sources_of_class
description: Read the source of every method of a class, each under its selector and grouped by the method category it is filed under, in the order the class holds its categories, so that a whole class is read at once. A category holding no method is left out. Name the class side the way it prints, as in MCPServer class.

className.description: Name of the class, or of its class side as in MCPServer class

name: smalltalk_classify_methods
description: File methods of a class under a method category, making the category when the class does not have it yet and taking away the ones they left behind when nothing else is filed under them. Answers where each method was filed before, which is what nothing says once it has moved.

className.description: Name of the class, or of its class side as in MCPServer class

selectors.description: Selectors of the methods to file, separated by commas

category.description: Name of the method category to file them under

name: smalltalk_delete_class
description: Remove several classes from the system in one call, in the order named, and answer the ones removed.

classNames.description: Names of the classes to remove, separated by commas

name: smalltalk_method_source
description: Read the source code of several methods in one call, each under its name as Class>>#selector, in the source field.

methods.description: The methods, written as Class>>selector and separated by commas. A class side is named the way it prints, as in MCPServer class>>startUp:

name: smalltalk_screenshot
description: Write what the image looks like right now to a JPEG file and answer the name of the file, so that a change to something on screen can be looked at instead of guessed at.

fileName.description: Absolute path of the JPEG file to write

name: smalltalk_evaluate
description: Evaluate arbitrary Smalltalk code and return the result.

name: smalltalk_change_package_description
description: Change what a package describes itself as, which is the line its file carries as its header. Changing it leaves the package with changes to write out.

description.description: What the package describes itself as

name: smalltalk_unsaved_packages
description: List the packages that hold changes their file does not have yet, which are the ones a change to the image left to be written out.

name: smalltalk_change_package_requirements
description: Change the packages a package requires, replacing the ones it required with the ones named, and answer what it requires now. Each requirement asks for any version.

requiredPackageNames.description: Names of the packages it requires, separated by commas. An empty text leaves it requiring nothing

name: smalltalk_run_test_class
description: Run every test of a test case class and answer how many tests passed, failed and signalled an error, along with the name of each one that failed and each one that signalled.

className.description: Name of the test case class

name: smalltalk_run_tests_in_category
description: Run every test of the test case classes of several class categories as one suite and answer how many tests passed, failed and signalled an error, along with the name of each one that failed and each one that signalled. A category holding no test case class contributes the tests that exercise the classes it does hold.

categoryNames.description: Names of the class categories, separated by commas

name: smalltalk_change_package_file_name
description: Name the file a package is written to, and answer it. A package that was never written, or whose image was moved away from where it was written, does not know one and cannot be saved until it is told.

fileName.description: Absolute path of the .pck.st file the package is written to

name: smalltalk_run_tests_for_classes
description: Run the tests of several classes as one suite and answer how many tests passed, failed and signalled an error, along with the name of each one that failed and each one that signalled. A class that is not a test case class contributes the tests that exercise it.

classNames.description: Names of the classes, separated by commas

name: smalltalk_class_organization
description: List, for each class named, its method categories, each with the selectors filed under it, in the order the class holds them. Name the class side the way it prints, as in MCPServer class.

classNames.description: Names of the classes, separated by commas. A class side is named the way it prints, as in MCPServer class

name: smalltalk_method_sources_in_category
description: Read the source of every method a class files under one of its method categories, each under its selector, so that what a category says is read at once instead of a method at a time. Name the class side the way it prints, as in MCPServer class.

className.description: Name of the class, or of its class side as in MCPServer class

name: smalltalk_subclasses
description: Answer, for each class named, its direct subclasses.

classNames.description: Names of the classes, separated by commas. A class side is named the way it prints, as in MCPServer class

name: smalltalk_define_class
description: Define a new class or modify an existing class definition.

name: smalltalk_list_packages
description: List the code packages installed in the image, each with what it describes itself as and whether it holds changes its file does not have yet, optionally filtered by prefix.

prefix.description: Optional prefix to filter package names

name: smalltalk_methods_in_category
description: List the selectors a class files under one of its method categories. Name the class side the way it prints, as in MCPServer class.

className.description: Name of the class, or of its class side as in MCPServer class

name: smalltalk_delete_method
description: Remove several methods of a class in one call, and answer the ones removed. A selector the class does not implement fails the whole call before anything is removed.

className.description: Name of the class, or of its class side as in MCPServer class

selectors.description: Selectors of the methods to remove, separated by commas

name: smalltalk_define_methods
description: Define or modify several methods in one call, each on its class and under its category. Every method is compiled whatever happens to the others, and the answer says for each one, in the order sent, whether it was defined and its selector, or why it was not.

methods.description: The methods to define, each with the class, the source and optionally the category

className.description: Name of the class, or of its class side as in MCPServer class

category.description: Optional method category. Defaults to as yet unclassified

name: smalltalk_hierarchy
description: Answer, for each class named, the class and all its superclasses, from the class up to ProtoObject.

classNames.description: Names of the classes, separated by commas. A class side is named the way it prints, as in MCPServer class

name: smalltalk_package_of_method
description: Answer the package a method belongs to, which is the package of its class unless it is filed under a method category naming another one, as an extension of a package is.

className.description: Name of the class that implements the method

name: smalltalk_list_categories
description: List all system categories.

name: smalltalk_save_package
description: Write a package to its file and answer the name of the file it was written to.

name: smalltalk_run_test_method
description: Run one test and answer how many tests passed, failed and signalled an error, along with the name of each one that failed and each one that signalled.

className.description: Name of the class that implements the method

name: smalltalk_classes_in_category
description: List all classes in a specific category.

name: smalltalk_package_of_class
description: Answer the package a class belongs to, which is the one a change to the class leaves with changes to write out.

className.description: Name of the class, or of its class side as in MCPServer class

name: smalltalk_package_definition
description: Read the definition of a code package: what it describes itself as, the file it is written to, whether the image holds changes that file does not, what it requires, and the system categories and classes it holds.

name: smalltalk_save_image
description: Save the Smalltalk image to disk.

name: smalltalk_class_definition
description: Read the definition of several classes in one call: for each, its superclass, its instance and class variables, its selectors and its comment.

classNames.description: Names of the classes, separated by commas. A class side is named the way it prints, as in MCPServer class

name: smalltalk_class_source
description: Read whole classes in one call. For each class named: its definition as it is written, its comment, the source of every method of its instance side under its selector and grouped by category, and under classSide the definition and the methods of its class side. A class side named answers the whole class. A category holding no method is left out.

classNames.description: Names of the classes, separated by commas. A class side is named the way it prints, as in MCPServer class
